files.name: config.yml
files.code:
metrics: true
update-checker: true
server:
  address: "HOST"
  port: 25565
resource-pack:
  uuid: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  auto_apply:
    enabled: true
    before_join: true
    delay_ticks: 1
  kick-player-on-decline: true
  kick-player-on-fail: true
  hosting:
    no-host:
      enabled: false
    simple_self_host:
      enabled: true
      server_address: "HOST"
      optimization:
        block_non_game_requests: true
        max_downloads_per_ip: 5
        max_speed_in_megabyte_ps: 30
    lobfile:
      enabled: false
    external-host:
      enabled: false
      url: ''
      skip_url_file_type_check: false
    self-host:
      enabled: false
      server-ip: "HOST"
      pack-port: 25565
      append-port: true
      protection:
        block_non_game_requests: false
        rate_limit:
          enabled: true
          max_requests: 3
          period_seconds: 2
          cooldown:
            enabled: true
            duration_minutes: 30
            trigger_on_failed_times: 5
  title:
    enabled: true
  fix_force_unicode_font_images: true
  allow_other_plugins_resourcepacks: true
  notify_other_plugins_resourcepacks: true
  protect-player:
    lock-player: true
    cancel_commands: true
    cancel_teleport: true
    force_cancel_movement: true
  command:
    usage-cooldown-seconds: 60
  custom-font:
    enabled: false
    name: ipaexg.ttf
    shift: '[0,0]'
    size: 11.0
    oversample: 2.0
  thin-font:
    enabled: false
  zip:
    extract_internal_utility_assets: true
    protect-file-from-unzip:
      protection_1: true
      protection_2: true
      protection_3: true
      short_texture_references: true
    compress-png-files: true
    compress-json-files: true
    compress-shader-files: true
    validate-shader-files: true
    compress_sounds:
      enabled: true
      bitrate_quality: 100
    custom_armors_shaders_legacy:
      vanilla:
        overwrite_leather_layers: true
        generate_shader:
          1_21_4_lower: true
          1_21_5_plus: true
      optifine:
        generate_cit:
          1_20_4_lower: false
    emotes:
      legacy_shaders: false
      1_21_5_to_1_21_9_shaders: false
      1_21_4_plus_modern_method: true
    models:
      fix_dark_in_inventory: true
      fix_missing_particle: true
      log_non_standard_rotations: true
      fix_1_21_11_plus_atlas_items_models:
        enabled: true
        models: []
    ignore-files-ext:
    - db
    - yml
    - xcf
    - psd
    - html
    - gz
    - rar
    - zip
    - 7z
    contents-folders-priority:
    - vanilla
    - _iainternal
    merge_other_plugins_resourcepacks_folders:
    - ModelEngine/resource pack
  items:
    CustomModelData-starting-value:
      ALL: 10000
      DIAMOND: 11000
  custom_blocks_sounds_patch:
    enabled: true
    step: true
    other: true
  pre_1_21_2_shaders_fix:
    enabled: true
config_files:
  lang: en
  dictionaries-lang: en
  force-sync-loading: false
blocks:
  custom:
    note: true
    mushroom: true
    chorus: true
    wire: false
    fire: false
    entity:
      enabled: true
      render-radius: 48
      max-displays-per-player: 512
      max-blocks-per-chunk: 256 # 设为 0 可关闭放置数量限制。
